seed.tagline: Your Shopify products, customers and orders in your rulebook, kept current by sync and webhooks.
seed.description: Adds a node-shopify/ folder to a project that has the Backend API add-in: ShopifyProducts, ShopifyCustomers and ShopifyOrders rulebook tables (with derived fields), a Node module for the generated Express API that signs in to Shopify (client credentials, OAuth install or a static token), copies the store's data in with incremental GraphQL syncs, verifies and applies Shopify webhooks including the three privacy ones, and keeps the access token in a private schema no signed-in person can read; plus an admin web component. One store per project. Zero runtime dependencies.
seed.stack: Shopify Admin GraphQL, Postgres, Express, Web components
seed.requiresInput: A Shopify app (client id and secret from the Dev Dashboard) installed on your store

replacements.label: Store
replacements.description: Your store's myshopify.com address, for example my-store.myshopify.com.

replacements.label: App client id
replacements.description: From your app's Settings in the Shopify Dev Dashboard. Public.

replacements.label: App client secret
replacements.description: From the same page. It signs in to Shopify and verifies webhooks, so it is kept as a secret and read from the environment at run time.

replacements.label: How the app signs in
replacements.description: client_credentials for a store in your own Shopify organization, oauth when a merchant installs the app, token for a legacy custom-app token.

replacements.label: Access scopes
replacements.description: Comma-separated. Orders older than 60 days also need read_all_orders.

replacements.label: Admin API version
replacements.description: A Shopify API version, for example 2026-07.

replacements.label: Public app URL
replacements.description: The https address this app is served at: where Shopify sends webhooks and OAuth returns. Blank until published.
